== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Dark Jedi Lightsaber, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 16 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of January 1, 2013” (PDF made 16 April 2013): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf source], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Dark Jedi Lightsaber (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].
